title: Agent Model Mapping for Claude Code Infinity Mode

direct.description: Direct routing to specified model without advanced features like reasoning

default.description: Standard routing for most tasks - uses GPT-5.1 Codex via Bifrost responses endpoint with reasoning

think.description: Thinking/reasoning tasks - uses GPT-5.1 Codex via responses endpoint with reasoning

longContext.description: Extended context for architectural and strategic work - uses Kimi K2 (1M token window)
longContext.note: Only activates when context exceeds 160k tokens (longContextThreshold). Reserved for massive codebases and comprehensive analysis.

media.note: Agent uses GPT-4o for prompt engineering and parameter optimization, then routes generation requests to specialized models (Sora 2, Veo 3, DALL-E 3) via Bifrost media endpoint

strengths: lower latency via Bifrost responses endpoint

notes.usage: This file is owned by the AI Nerd (🤓) and defines model assignments for all specialist agents
notes.legacy_mode: When running in Legacy mode (direct Anthropic API), agents use the 'model:' field from their agent definition files
notes.infinity_mode: When running in Infinity mode (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL set), agents can use models defined in this file
notes.routing_flow: Claude Code CLI → Claude Code Router (port 3456) → Bifrost Gateway (port 8083) → Provider APIs
notes.fallback_strategy: If infinity_model is unavailable, use fallback. If fallback fails, use legacy model field
notes.model_id_convention: Model IDs use router convention with provider prefix (e.g., openrouter/minimax/minimax-m2). Bifrost strips the prefix for provider routing.
notes.model_status_2026_01: All model IDs verified current as of January 2026. GPT-5.1-Codex and GPT-5-Codex confirmed active in Bifrost. OpenRouter models verified: Kimi K2, MiniMax M2, Gemini 3 Pro.
notes.groq_status: Groq provider configured in Bifrost but API key access needs to be fixed before activation
notes.active_providers: OpenAI (GPT-5.1-Codex, GPT-5-Codex, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini), OpenRouter (Gemini 3 Pro, Kimi K2, MiniMax M2), Together AI (FLUX models), Fal AI (FLUX Pro, Sora 2), Replicate (FLUX models)
notes.agent_consolidation_2026_01: Deprecated agents removed: Content Marketer, Marketing Analyst, Social Media Marketer (consolidated into CMO). Added: Venture Analyst, Chief Marketing Officer.
notes.visual_media_update_2026_01: Updated Camera Man (formerly Visual Media Generator) to use Gemini 3 Pro multimodal model. Image/video generation routes to specialized models via Bifrost (FLUX family, Sora 2).
